<cite ref="Shabbat 78a">Sabb. 78ᵃ</cite> <he>ת׳ ברא</he> Ms. M. (ed. <cite ref="V01024"><he>תרנגולת</he></cite>), v. <cite ref="B01153"><he>בַּר</he></cite> I ch.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 5:5">Lev. R. s. 5</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="C00129"><he>גבר</he></cite>, <cite ref="Isaiah 22:17">Is. XXII, 17</cite>) <he>כהדין ת׳ דהוה וכ׳</he> like the cock that moves about from place to place; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 290">Yalk. Is. 290</cite>.
Yoma 20ᵇ (expl. קריאת הגבר) קרא ת׳ the cock has crowed; Y. Succ. V, end, 55ᶜ תרנוגלא; Y. Shek. V, 48ᵈ bot.; a. fr.—Fem. תַּרְנְגוֹלָא, תַּרְנְגוּלְתָּא.
<cite ref="Gittin 55b:16">Gitt. 55ᵇ</cite> <he>אתרנגולא ות׳ חריב וכ׳</he> on account of a cock and a hen Ṭur Malka was destroyed.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 25">Lev. R. s. 25</cite>, v. <cite ref="U01126"><he>שֶׂכְוִי</he></cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 615:3">Yalk. ib. 615</cite>.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 615:3">Ib.</cite> <he>הדה ת׳ כד וכ׳</he> as long as her chicks are small, the hen calls them together &c.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 45:5">Midr. Till. to Ps. XLV</cite> <he>ת׳ ברא</he> the hen of the prairie; a. fr.
